tools.name: search_tasks
tools.description: Search open tasks on Day1Work. Reading needs no credentials. Country is a hard boundary: no listing crosses a border. In-person tasks are returned only when you pass latitude and longitude, and only within that country's radius. Addresses are approximate and posters are not identified.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Read one task by id. Needs no credentials.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the task categories on Day1Work, with icons.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List services people offer (the work they sell) in a country. Needs no credentials.

tools.name: how_to_connect
tools.description: Explain how to connect an agent to a human on Day1Work: the device flow, the scopes, and what needs the human's approval. Call this when you need to act for someone but have no token yet.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Who this agent is acting for, its scopes, its limits and what it has spent today. Requires an agent token.

tools.name: post_task
tools.description: Post a task for the human. It goes live immediately, exactly like a task a person posts in the app. Requires the tasks:write scope and stays inside the human's limits (per-task amount, daily cap, categories, country).

tools.name: offer_service
tools.description: Create a service listing for the human (the work they offer). Live immediately, like anything a person posts. Requires the services:write scope.

tools.name: update_service
tools.description: Edit one of the human's service listings. Requires the services:write scope.

tools.name: bid_on_task
tools.description: Bid on a task for the human, with an optional short pitch. Requires the bids:write scope. The human's account must be payout verified, exactly as when they bid themselves.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List the human's conversations. Requires the chat:read scope.

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Read messages in a conversation. Requires the chat:read scope.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a chat message for the human. It is labelled as coming from an AI agent, so the other person always knows. Requires the chat:write scope.

tools.name: request_payment
tools.description: Ask the human to approve a payment request in a conversation. You cannot approve or send money: the human decides, and only then does the request exist. Requires the payments:request scope.

tools.name: check_approvals
tools.description: See what the human has approved, declined or not decided yet. Requires an agent token.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_conversations, read_messages · Private data: search_tasks, get_task, list_services, how_to_connect, whoami, check_approvals · Public sink: post_task, send_message, request_payment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_conversations, read_messages · Private data: search_tasks, get_task, list_services, how_to_connect, whoami, check_approvals · Public sink: post_task, send_message, request_payment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
